purpose: Teach: 陽子/高山/高松/佐賀/島根/日本橋/水田/淵

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの陽子と仲良いな
lines.en: Riku, you're pretty close with Yoko from the class next door, aren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing opener. Casual lean-in, eyebrow slightly raised. Watching for a reaction. The tone of someone who's noticed something and is enjoying keeping it easy so he doesn't shut down.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で飛騨高山行ったろ、桜
lines.en: What, you went to Hida-Takayama on the school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick deflection, but not defensive. Slight lift at the end, turning her question back on her with the same lightness she used. Eyes bright—he's caught her noticing him and he's pointing it out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏休みに香川県の高松行ったな
lines.en: Riku, you went to Takamatsu in Kagawa over summer break, didn't you?
lines.style: Undeterred. Pushing back with the same rhythm, same pattern. A little faster now—this is becoming a game and she's competing. Slight smile at the corner of her mouth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で佐賀の歴史調べてたな、桜
lines.en: You were researching Saga's history for social studies, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her energy beat for beat. No hesitation now. Building momentum—each return faster, more assured. He's got his own observations locked and loaded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、出雲、つまり島根の神社行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you went to that shrine in Izumo—Shimane—didn't you?
lines.style: Rhythm tightening. She's keeping pace, slightly breathless now. The game is accelerating. Precision on the place names—she's done her homework too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、東京の日本橋で買い物してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were shopping at Nihonbashi in Tokyo with your family, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Rapid-fire now, almost overlapping her sentence. The deflection has become a volleys match. Energy building but still playful—no actual heat, just competitive delight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で水田の田植え手伝ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you helped your family plant rice in the paddies, didn't you?
lines.style: Pushing harder, slightly breathless. She's running through her ammunition. Each fact delivered with precision, staccato rhythm. Still grinning underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林間学校で川の淵で水遊びしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were messing around in the river at forest school, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Final volley, delivered with dry satisfaction. Slight smirk. Breath settling slightly. He's saved this one for last—a small win. The rhythm finally breaks with a beat of quiet triumph.
